findings.finding: LOCAL_ONLY performed a policy DNS resolution before httpx performed its own connection-time resolution, leaving a DNS-rebinding TOCTOU window.
findings.remediation: LOCAL_ONLY now accepts only localhost or private/loopback IP literals and rejects arbitrary DNS names and link-local addresses fail-closed.

findings.finding: Billing callback size ceiling was checked after Request.body() buffered the complete attacker-controlled body.
findings.remediation: Introduced streamed 64 KiB application boundary with early Content-Length refusal and cumulative chunk ceiling.

findings.finding: pyproject declared pypdf <6 while the runtime lock pinned pypdf 6.14.2.
findings.remediation: Declaration aligned to >=6.14,<7 and a gate now proves every declared runtime dependency accepts its exact lock version.

findings.finding: Uploaded mutation catalogue contained 21 targets no longer present in the current source plus one stale test citation; old mutation PASS could therefore certify obsolete call-sites.
findings.remediation: All stale targets were re-anchored to current modules; catalogue now has 246 unique full IDs and structural reachability/cited-test gates pass. Changed-risk probe killed 23/23 mutants.
findings.open: Fresh complete execution of all 246 mutants exceeded the available execution ceiling, so full mutation assurance remains unclosed.

findings.finding: ENOSPC reliability test monkeypatched a stale aggregate module and no longer struck the actual spool implementation.
findings.remediation: Negative control now patches routes_corpus, restoring reachability of the failure path.

findings.finding: snapshot_assurance.py failed when loaded via importlib file-spec because sibling release_identity was not importable.
findings.remediation: Script directory is inserted explicitly before sibling import; existing module budget preserved.

findings.finding: A ~9.9 MiB candidate .bundle was shipped inside the source tree and violated the repository's own oversized-file invariant.
findings.remediation: Removed candidate bundle from canonical source package; release evidence remains in reports rather than source-manifest scope.
